seo.title: Platform Features: Skills, CRM, Analytics & More | Steps AI
seo.description: Explore Steps AI features for analytics, lead capture, CRM, ticketing, agent skills, integrations, and omnichannel AI automation.

hero.title: Everything your AI agent and your team need, in one place.
hero.body: Give your agent skills, keep every conversation in one inbox, track customers in the CRM and see what is working. Pick a feature to see how it works.

cta.title: Want to see these features on your business?
cta.body: Book a demo and we will show you how Steps AI would work with your customers and your tools.

cards.label: Agent skills
cards.body: Book appointments, create tickets, save leads and hand over to your team, with rules you write in plain English.

cards.label: Unified inbox
cards.body: Every conversation from every agent and channel in one inbox. Take over from the AI and reply as your team.

cards.label: Human handoff
cards.body: Let your team claim a request and reply with the full conversation history.

cards.label: CRM
cards.body: Customer records, support tickets and live requests from every chat in one place, or sent to HubSpot.

cards.label: Analytics
cards.body: See how many chats your agents handle, what customers ask and which channels they use.

cards.label: Workflow builder
cards.body: Recover carts, confirm COD orders and send updates with ready-made workflows, or build your own without code.

cards.label: WhatsApp broadcasting
cards.body: Send personalised WhatsApp campaigns to the right customers. Your AI agent answers every reply.
